observation_summary: The CSV parser failed to increment the line number when processing input containing carriage return ('\r') line separators.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by the ExtendedBufferedReader only incrementing the line counter when encountering a newline character ('\n'). This failed to account for files using carriage return ('\r') as a line terminator, which is a valid line separator in many contexts. The fix updates the read() method to increment the line counter when either a '\r' is encountered or a '\n' is encountered that is not preceded by a '\r' (to correctly handle CRLF sequences).
